heading: EXT. CITY HALL PLAZA - CLIMATE PROTEST - DAY

units.text: EXT. CITY HALL PLAZA - CLIMATE PROTEST - DAY
A sea of cardboard signs.
Drums somewhere.
Sunny, 20s, they/them, stands on a milk crate holding a megaphone and a coffee.
Beside them, Mel checks a phone.
Troy ties a banner to a lamp post.
Rhea films everything.
At the edge of the crowd, a figure in a black hoodie watches the steps of City Hall and does not chant.
ON PHONE (SLACK): #march-ops - Mel: are we on for 2?
Sunny: yes.
Troy: banner is up.
Rhea: live in 5.
Okay, team, small update. Permit says we can stay until four. Which means we leave at five.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Sunny.
units.name: MEL

units.text: They said four, I said five, it's a negotiation. They'll adjust.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Who is they?
units.name: MEL

units.text: Me. I'm they. Wait, you mean the city. Sorry, the city. The city is it.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Hey, Sunny, who's the hoodie guy? He's been standing there for an hour. Hasn't touched a sign.
units.name: TROY

units.text: I'm going to say it. He is giving cop.
units.name: RHEA

units.text: He's giving bored dad.
units.name: MEL

units.text: Bored dads wear fleece, Mel. That is a tactical hoodie.
units.name: RHEA

units.text: Okay, let's not be weird. Everyone's allowed to stand. It's a public plaza.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: He's been looking at your crate for ten minutes.
units.name: TROY

units.text: That's because I'm very tall on a crate.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: Hoodie guy, if you're a cop, please blink twice.
units.name: RHEA

units.text: The Hoodie Guy takes a step into the crowd, lowers the hood, and walks right up to the crate.
He is Ansel, 30s, tired, pink-eyed, holding an envelope.
Sunny? I'm Ansel. From the water board. I'm the one who emailed you last night.
units.name: HOODIE GUY

units.text: Oh. You're the leak.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: I'm the leak. Can we walk? There are more documents. They're not going to like me after today.
units.name: ANSEL

units.text: Is that why you're being weird in a hoodie?
units.name: MEL

units.text: I'm not being weird. I'm being careful.
units.name: ANSEL

units.text: Careful looks exactly like weird, man.
units.name: TROY

units.text: Rhea, stop the livestream. Mel, take the megaphone. Troy, keep the banner up. I'll be five minutes.
units.name: SUNNY

units.text: It's been "five minutes" for three years.
units.name: RHEA

units.text: Then it's right on time.
units.name: SUNNY
